1.07.pattern: move is/are to the end or behind the complement (The plate white and clean is)
1.07.en: The verb is in the wrong place: “{right}”.

1.13.pattern: have + noun for a state expressed with be (I have cold for I am cold, She has hunger)

3.14.pattern: every day/every Sunday between the object and the place phrase (wears the skirt every Sunday in the park)
3.14.en: Put the time phrase at the end: “{right}”.

6.15.pattern: the instead of my/his/her/its before a body part that is the object (She raised the hand)

8.17.pattern: the instead of my/his/her/its before a body part that is the object (She raised the hand)

9.09.pattern: Who does live… / What does happen… when asking about the subject
9.09.sk: Keď sa pýtaš na podmet, bez „do“: „{right}“.
9.09.cz: Když se ptáš na podmět, bez „do“: „{right}“.
9.09.en: When asking about the subject, no “do”: “{right}”.

10.04.pattern: at the morning / at the evening / on the evening / in night
10.04.sk: Hovorí sa „in the morning/evening“, ale „at night“: „{right}“.
10.04.cz: Říká se „in the morning/evening“, ale „at night“: „{right}“.

10.06.pattern: on for something inside (on the box, on the drawer)

10.07.pattern: on/in for at a point or place (in the bus stop, on the traffic lights)
10.07.en: At a point or place, use “at”: “{right}”.

12.11.kind: was + verb instead of Past Simple
12.11.pattern: was/were + verb for the plain active past (was stop, was went)
12.11.en: No “was/were” needed; Past Simple is just “{right}”.

14.13.pattern: the instead of my/his/her/its before a body part that is the object (She raised the hand)

14.19.pattern: drop an optional the; grammatical but less natural

15.17.pattern: flat adverb where the -ly form is more standard (croak loud, walk slow)
15.17.en: With a verb, use the -ly form: “{right}”.

16.06.pattern: will + adjective/noun without be (will ready, will happy)

16.17.pattern: add a word English does not use here (return back, discuss about)

19.15.pattern: these/those before an uncountable noun (these cheese)

31.01.kind: Past Simple for action in progress
31.01.pattern: Past Simple of an action verb for the longer action in progress when something happened (read for was reading)
31.01.sk: Dej, ktorý práve prebiehal, vyjadruje Past Continuous: „{right}“, nie „{wrong}“.
31.01.cz: Děj, který právě probíhal, vyjadřuje Past Continuous: „{right}“, ne „{wrong}“.
31.01.en: An action in progress at that moment needs Past Continuous: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

34.08.pattern: have/has + Past Simple form of an irregular verb (has went, has took)
34.08.en: After “have/has” use the past participle: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

41.03.pattern: be + Past Simple form of an irregular verb (was rewrote, is showed)
41.03.sk: V Passive patrí past participle: „{right}“, nie „{wrong}“.
41.03.cz: V Passive patří past participle: „{right}“, ne „{wrong}“.
41.03.en: Passive needs the past participle: “{right}”, not “{wrong}”.

40.10.pattern: could + verb where the native sentence has plain by/bych (would), no ability meant (customs could let them through)
40.10.en: “could” means “would be able to”; here the meaning is “{right}”.

48.10.pattern: amn't I / isn't I / am not I after I am
48.10.sk: Po „I am“ je Question tag „aren't I?“: „{right}“.
48.10.cz: Po „I am“ je Question tag „aren't I?“: „{right}“.
48.10.en: After “I am” the Question tag is “aren't I?”: “{right}”.

47.15.pattern: was able to / could for podarilo sa
47.15.en: “{right}” best expresses that it worked out.

53.20.pattern: still placed after be instead of right after would (would be still here, would be still crying)

56.18.pattern: insisted on + -ing instead of insisted that …
56.18.sk: „Insisted on“ + -ing znamená trvať na čine; „tvrdiť, že“ je „insisted that“.
56.18.cz: „Insisted on“ + -ing znamená trvat na činu; „tvrdit, že“ je „insisted that“.
56.18.en: “insisted on” + -ing means demanding to do it; to claim something, use “insisted that”.

61.18.pattern: the instead of her/his before a body part that is the object (The stag lowered the head)
61.18.sk: Pri častiach tela patrí v angličtine privlastňovacie zámeno: „{right}“.
61.18.cz: U částí těla patří v angličtině přivlastňovací zájmeno: „{right}“.
61.18.en: Body parts take a possessive in English: “{right}”.

67.13.kind: Future Perfect Continuous for a result
67.13.pattern: will have been + -ing for a finished result
67.13.sk: Pri hotovom výsledku patrí Future Perfect Simple: „{right}“.
67.13.cz: U hotového výsledku patří Future Perfect Simple: „{right}“.
67.13.en: A finished result takes Future Perfect Simple: “{right}”.
